name: Raja Roy
title: Backend Software Engineer
summary: I’m a backend engineer with 4 years of experience building APIs, lending platforms, and compliance systems across fintech and security. I work on stateful, asynchronous workflows, database design, service integrations, and production reliability.
focus: APIs that work. Systems that recover.
focus_description: From lending decisions to payroll compliance, I build the workflows behind the product — with clear state transitions, dependable data, and a way back when things fail.

experience.intro: Building reliable payroll and compliance workflows, from API and schema design to reconciliation, incident response, and recovery.
highlights: Owned PF workflow reliability improvements for 1,500+ organizations, resolving calculation, integration, and recovery failures to help improve automated payment success to approximately 99%.

Designed Master Transaction Record state tracking for payment workflows in a Temporal-orchestrated service, with error classification, retries, reconciliation, and recovery for stuck or partial workflows.
Developed Quicko-integrated TDS APIs for CSI file handling, FVU generation, filing orchestration, audit logging, and idempotent processing.
Automated KAPT calculation and payments for approximately 1,000 organizations; built a reconciliation engine to match bank payment data with internal ledger records.
Reworked employee onboarding into a draft-first flow supporting progressive completion.

experience.intro: Built lending integrations, configurable decision systems, and asynchronous workflows for partner and operations teams.
highlights: Built a Business Rules Engine for Khatabook and other lending partners handling approximately 1,000–2,000 eligibility requests per day, replacing a paid third-party solution.
Integrated CKYC search and download through certificate-based APIs, CRIF credit assessment, and existing-customer eligibility checks.
Improved lending APIs through Redis caching, request batching, and SQL optimization; built asynchronous workflows with Python, NestJS, FastAPI, Flask, BullMQ, and RabbitMQ.
Designed a bulk CSV loan-booking approach and service architecture targeting approximately 100,000 records per day.
Received the Q1 FY 2024–25 Certificate of Appreciation for contributions to technology and innovation.

experience.intro: Worked on security detection and event analysis across Linux and Windows environments.
highlights: Built a Python-based detection tool analyzing Elasticsearch event streams.
Implemented real-time alerts for port and host scans, attack patterns, and login anomalies to support proactive threat investigation.

project.name: RoleOS
project.label: AI job-search platform · personal project
project.description: A job-search platform that turns a résumé and job description into an explainable fit assessment, identifies gaps, supports interview preparation, and tracks applications.
highlights: FastAPI and PostgreSQL backend with résumé parsing, staged discovery, and deterministic matching.
React and TypeScript frontend with account isolation and authentication.
AI assistance with validated outputs and deterministic fallbacks so core matching remains usable without model credentials.
